notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the Food or Clue token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
